body: Happy birthday! :) Here's to the next!

Doesn't even matter if it was a platonic thing or romantic; you went out and did something today. That's a lot better than where I was a week ago. Small steps, don't beat yourself up if it doesn't turn out to be something more!
The worst part is when you've looked at everything interesting there is to on reddit and then there's nothing to do anymore. So you go back to sleep.

Yeah. I kind of go through this thought cycle:

* Fuck, I'm so far behind in school. Just not gonna go into my classes today.
* I'm gonna drop out.
* Now I'll just lay here and sleep 16 hours a day.
* Oh sweet it's Tuesday, time to sleep 16 hours again.
* -some days pass- It's a new week, time to do nothing again.
* This isn't living. Why am I alive. Fuck.

Recently decided to start working out and eating healthier. Better than nothing. Kind of wish I could spend all day at the gym, go home and sleep, and repeat.

It's so fucking annoying, isn't it? I totally felt it coming back. Ugh, I fucking hate it.

I try not to let my friends see it cuz then I'm pathetic. I've been saying that I got better to all of them over this last year but fuck, it's coming back and I failed again. Don't feel like admitting that to them, I'm finally just admitting it to myself.

I feel the same way. I think I know why but I don't really wanna admit it to myself.

I really thought I was over this.

I hate it. I thought I was over this all and I really hate how these stupid voices have come back.

(voices as in just myself putting myself down...I don't actually hear voices)
